items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: But there were ones with Pettis, they were Victor. He was, he was supposed to be exclusive, Victor. Victor. And the name of the band was Jack Pettis and his Pets.

ctx.x: Do you remember any of the tunes that you made for Pettis?

Well, that's another thing Dick. See each one of those, each one of those big companies had what they called house names. They had a name called the Knickerbockers, they had a name called the Campus Boys, they had the Charleston Chasers, the Lads Black Aces, Bailey's Lucky Seven, Ted Wallace and his Campus Boys. Oh, they had about 15 different names, you see. And every band that recorded would record on the, for instance if you had a good band, and you were contracted to, to, to, to Victor. Well then you couldn't…
Yeah, he used his own name on it.
